shots.content: Rainy riverside settlement at dawn; wooden landing, wet bamboo baskets, extinguished paper lamps; ripples; open center walkway; no people.
Frayed rope slides along a wet wooden landing; small parcel presses against the edge; rope catches on a bamboo peg; no human hands.
Rain-wet bronze bell shape visible only in the water reflection beneath a wooden pier; no bell above the water; one ripple interrupts the shape.
shots.panelFix: Bell drawn solid under the pier in v1; v2 removes the solid bell entirely — only its reflection ripples on the water, one ripple interrupting the reflected shape (per pack).

shots.content: Five-groove seal on a closed rain-dark envelope in the courier's open satchel; one drop runs across the wax; seal intact; letter content not shown.
Ly An kneels to stop a small wooden parcel sliding toward water; looks toward an offscreen helper, not at camera.
